description_en: Queries the status of a short URL to determine whether the short URL is available
description_zh: 查询短链状态，可判断短链是否可用
name: QueryShortUrl

parameters.help_en:
The short URL. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/186774.html operation to obtain the short URL.
<notice>Short Message Service (SMS) does not support this operation.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
生成的短链服务地址。可通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/186774.html接口获取。
<notice>短信服务暂时不支持使用此接口。></notice>
parameters.name: short_url

Code.description_en:
The request status code.

OK indicates that the request was successful.
For other error codes, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/101346.html）
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。

返回OK代表请求成功。
其他错误码，请参见[错误码列表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/101346.html）

Data.description_en: The details of the short URL

CreateDate.description_en: The time when the short URL was created in the YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format
CreateDate.description_zh: 短链创建时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss

ExpireDate.description_en: The expiration time of the short URL in the YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format
ExpireDate.description_zh: 短链失效时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss

PageViewCount.description_en: The page view (PV) data of the short URL

ShortUrlName.description_en: The service name of the short URL

ShortUrlStatus.description_en:
The status of the short URL. Valid values:

expired: Expired.
effective: Active.
audit: Under review.
reject: Rejected
ShortUrlStatus.description_zh:
短链状态。取值：

expired：失效。
effective：有效。
audit：审核中。
reject：审核拒绝

UniqueVisitorCount.description_en: The unique visitor (UV) data of the short URL

Message.description_en: The description of the status code
